sources.name: Happow demo
sources.termsNotes: Hand-entered demo events for the PoC skeleton (milestone 1). Fictional programmes at real venues.

sources.name: Ticketmaster
sources.termsNotes: Discovery API v2. Free key: 5,000 calls/day, 5 req/s; deep paging capped at 1,000 results (size × page). Must link to the Ticketmaster event page for purchase and keep attribution; do not cache data beyond its freshness.

sources.name: Meetup
sources.termsNotes: GraphQL API (gql-ext) with OAuth JWT bearer flow; API access is a Meetup Pro feature. 500 points per 60 s. Link back to the Meetup event page; no member data is stored.

sources.name: eBilet
sources.termsNotes: Ticketing site; the city listing publishes schema.org Event JSON-LD (ItemList). Crawled page. Store facts only (title, time, place, price) and link back; no descriptions or images are republished. robots.txt is honoured; 1 request/s.

sources.name: wroclaw.pl GO
sources.termsNotes: City portal events; no public API or feed (brief: ask ARAW for one). Event pages publish schema.org Event JSON-LD. Crawled page. Store facts only (title, time, place, price) and link back; no descriptions or images are republished. robots.txt is honoured; 1 request/s.

sources.name: Narodowe Forum Muzyki
sources.termsNotes: Venue calendar without structured data: event pages go through LLM extraction (cached by content hash). Crawled page. Store facts only (title, time, place, price) and link back; no descriptions or images are republished. robots.txt is honoured; 1 request/s.

sources.name: Biletyna
sources.termsNotes: Ticketing site. The city listing (biletyna.pl/Wroclaw) publishes schema.org Event JSON-LD (an ItemList, 36 Wrocław events on 29 Oct 2026), so no event pages are followed. Checked 2026-10-29: robots.txt allows the listing (only cart, order, profile and event view/sector paths are disallowed) and sends Content-Signal ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes; the terms page (biletyna.pl/static/regulamin) shows no clause on automated reading, but its full text is not on the page. Switched on by the owner on 2026-10-30. Store facts only (title, time, place, price) and link back; no descriptions or images are republished. robots.txt is honoured; one request every 5 s.

sources.name: Miejska Biblioteka Publiczna we Wrocławiu
sources.termsNotes: The public library network (WordPress; no event feed or JSON-LD: its RSS gives publishing dates). Event pages from the listing go through LLM extraction (cached by content hash). Checked 2026-10-29: robots.txt allows everything. Switched on by the owner on 2026-10-30. Store facts only (title, time, place, price) and link back; no descriptions or images are republished. robots.txt is honoured; one request every 5 s.

sources.name: Uniwersytet Wrocławski
sources.termsNotes: University events (lectures, open days, concerts). No feed or JSON-LD; event pages go through LLM extraction (cached by content hash). Checked 2026-10-29: robots.txt answers 403 to our crawler (read as none), the events pages answer normally. The listing includes past events, so only upcoming ones are kept. Switched on by the owner on 2026-10-30. Store facts only (title, time, place, price) and link back; no descriptions or images are republished. robots.txt is honoured; one request every 5 s.

sources.name: Threads
sources.termsNotes: Threads API keyword search; needs the threads_keyword_search permission (Meta App Review), until then it only finds the token owner's own posts. Quota checked from config (queriesPer7Days). Only event facts and the post's link are stored: no author, no post text, no images. Off until App Review and a legal check of social sources.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap venues
sources.termsNotes: Venues (theatres, clubs, cinemas, community centres, libraries, places of worship, museums) from OpenStreetMap through Overpass, weekly. ODbL: attribution in About. Writes venues and links, never events.

sources.name: Venue website check
sources.termsNotes: Checks OSM venues' websites for an iCal feed, The Events Calendar's REST API or Event JSON-LD: at most five requests per site, robots.txt honoured, 5 s between requests. Finds go to the admin's candidate list; nothing is read from a site until an admin accepts it.

sources.name: Venue websites
sources.termsNotes: Sites an admin accepted from the website check (source_candidates): calendar feeds and pages the venues publish for others to read. Store facts only (title, time, place, price) and link back; no descriptions or images are republished. robots.txt is honoured.

sources.name: Regular services (OpenStreetMap)
sources.termsNotes: Service times from OpenStreetMap's service_times tag on places of worship (ODbL, attribution in About), read from the OSM venues already loaded; no requests of its own. Each service is its own event for the next 14 days. Holidays aren't known, so the weekly pattern simply runs; a report from the card removes one. Switched on by the owner on 2026-10-30.

sources.name: Account calendar feeds
sources.termsNotes: Calendar feeds (iCal) that signed-in accounts add for their own events. Their events come in as that account's submissions: the monthly quota, moderation until the feed's first event is approved, then the account's trust. One request per feed per run; robots.txt is not asked, since the account owner gave the address. An admin can stop a feed from the moderation queue.

sources.name: Happow community
sources.termsNotes: Events added by users through the app (URL autofill or form). Shown as unverified until a moderator approves them. Submitters are stored only as a salted device hash.
